svg.text: Cut a blank 114 wide x about 260 long (top 120, legs 58, feet 15;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check the bend allowance on a scrap first).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the legs down 90 degrees along the two long-side lines, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fold the feet outward 90 degrees at the bottom of each leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top 114 x 120 mm, 60 mm above the deck.
